mapper.select:
select c.* from billing_cdr_info c where 1=1
and (c.msisdn=#{number})
and UNIX_TIMESTAMP(c.timemark)*1000 between #{effectiveStartTime,jdbcType=BIGINT} and #{effectiveEndTime,jdbcType=BIGINT}
and (c.ssid=#{ssid})
ORDER BY c.timemark Desc
